lines.text: Somebody in this house has been eating my lunch for three weeks. Tonight... I find out who.

image.prompt: {avo} standing in front of an open glowing fridge at night holding an empty lunchbox, furious face, kitchen at night

lines.text: Every morning I pack it. Every lunch break... empty.

image.prompt: {avo} at an office desk opening an empty lunchbox, shocked and sad face, office background

lines.text: So I hid a tiny camera inside the fridge.

image.prompt: {avo} carefully hiding a tiny camera between jars inside a fridge, sneaky face, fridge light glowing

lines.text: Suspect number one. Melvin. My roommate. Gym bro. Eats twelve meals a day.

image.prompt: {melvin} flexing his biceps in a kitchen, confident grin, protein shake on the counter

lines.text: Suspect number two. Sue. Says she's on a diet... but she's always chewing.

image.prompt: {sue} standing in a living room chewing with puffed cheeks, guilty side eye, hiding something behind her back

lines.text: Two in the morning. My phone buzzes. Motion in the fridge.

image.prompt: {avo} in bed in a dark bedroom, face lit up blue by his phone screen, eyes wide

lines.label: 2:00 AM

lines.text: The door creaks open. I'm holding my breath.

image.prompt: view from inside a fridge looking out, the fridge door slowly opening in a dark kitchen, a shadowy figure in the doorway, suspenseful

lines.text: It's not Melvin. It's not Sue.

image.prompt: {melvin} and {sue} both asleep on a couch in a dark living room, snoring, moonlight

lines.text: It's my mom. In her bathrobe. Eating my sandwich with both hands.

image.prompt: {mom} standing in front of an open glowing fridge at night eating a huge sandwich with both hands, crumbs everywhere

lines.text: She looks straight into the camera...

image.prompt: extreme close-up of {mom} staring directly into the camera with a calm smirk, fridge light on her face
close-up of a hand sticking a yellow sticky note onto a tiny camera inside a fridge, fridge light
{avo} in the morning kitchen holding a yellow sticky note, jaw dropped, totally speechless

lines.text: So now I pack two lunches. And somehow... one is still missing.
